correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the first uniformly ordered vertex proves star law I_m∈{1,m} with probabilities 1/(m+1),m/(m+1). For the private pendant extension, first hub gives size 2, first new leaf reduces to K_{1,m−1} with one extra selected, first attachment leaf gives m, and any other old leaf leaves an edge plus isolated leaves, also m. Consequently P(I_m^+=2)=(m+1)/(m(m+2)), P(I_m^+=m)=1−this. Direct exact fraction subtraction gives a strict positive upper-tail difference at 2 and strict negative difference −1/[m(m+1)(m+2)] at m while mean increases (m²+m+2)/[m(m+1)(m+2)], for each integer m≥3. The only connected graphs on 1..3 vertices K1,K2,P3,K3 and their possible pendant attachments are exhausted, showing sharp minimum original order four. Independent rational first-vertex recursion corroborated m=3..8; finite enumeration is not used as all-m proof.
